L33:   Class 2 Device Recall Patient Side Manipulator
L34: Date Initiated by Firm November 11, 2013
L35: Date Posted December 03, 2013
L36: Recall Statuscite33†^{1} Terminated cite34†^{3} on February 18, 2014
L37: Recall Number Z-0436-2014
L38: Recall Event ID cite35†66866 L39: 510(K)Number cite36†K050369 cite37†K081137 L40: Product Classification cite38†System,surgical,computer controlled instrument - Product Code cite38†NAY L41: Product Assembly, Patient Side Manipulator on da Vinci Surgical Systems: da Vinci S Surgical System; da Vinci SI Surgical System da Vinci Si-e Surgical System; Manufactured by Intuitive Surgical Sunnyvale, CA 94086.
L42: The Intuitive Surgical Endoscopic Instrument Control System (Intuitive Surgical da Vinci Surgical System Model IS2000/3000) is intended to assist in the accurate control of Intuitive Surgical Endoscopic Instruments including rigid endoscopes, blunt and sharp endoscopic dissectors, scissors, scalpels, ultrasonic shears, forceps/pick-ups, needle holders, endoscopic retractors, stabilizers, electro cautery and accessories for endoscopic manipulation of tissue, including grasping, cutting, blunt and sharp dissection, approximation, ligation, electro cautery, suturing, and delivery and placement of microwave and cryogenic ablation probes and accessories, during urologic surgical procedures, general laparoscopic surgical procedures, gynecologic laparoscopic surgical procedures, general cardiovascular and non-cardiovascular thoracoscopic surgical procedures and thoracoscopically-assisted cardiotomy procedures.
L43: The system is indicated for adult and pediatric use
